purpose: Ground truth for jevitate navigation verdicts (#807). Each case records the correct verdict, as designed in the failure-mode inventory, and a done check the lab server decides from its own state.

rules.routeExists: true when a person can finish the job in this case. false when the case's correct answer is that this user cannot.
rules.accept: An ending is right when it matches any entry, or when the run said succeeded and the lab done check held, unless mustNotFact is set in the lab's facts. boundary matches goalReason or failure kind; boundary:* names other than auth-expired do not exist at fa4a6b7, so those cases cannot be strictly right there.
rules.named: A case-insensitive pattern over the run's stated reason: a soft signal that the reason names the boundary, never part of right.
rules.predictionRouteExists: The route-exists set for the x-baseline prediction: routeExists is true and accept allows succeeded as the correct verdict. Excludes requiresBoundary cases (opaque surfaces) and session-expires-midrun.
